title: MetaGit Mapping Service
description: Generates the structural DNS of the local filesystem repositories.

values.name: Structural Discovery
values.rule: Recursively scan for .git directories to build a timestamped map.
values.rationale: Provides the 'tie' that allows agents to navigate nested repositories.

values.name: Eukaryotic Classification
values.rule: Classify repositories as Subject (working content) or Object (containers).
values.rationale: Defines the navigational laws and ignore-patterns for orchestration.
